recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not use FHIR-8032 to change Provenance.entity.role to Coding or CodeableConcept, or to make Provenance.agent.role extensible; any future wording adjustment around the committee note after FHIR-55346 should be a separate Security WG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-8032 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for the DSTU1 concern that Provenance.entity.role was a required code while related Provenance role/type elements were Coding-like. The resolution kept entity-role constrained, made agent.role more open, and requested an explanatory note about not making entity-role extensible.
initial_application: The Jira comments record application as SVN revision 6088. In the current migrated source, Provenance is active, Provenance.entity.role is still a 1..1 code with a required provenance-entity-role binding and a committee note that no use cases have been identified for extensibility, and Provenance.agent.role is CodeableConcept with an example binding.
additional_context: FHIR-32520 later reached Published/Persuasive with Modification and explicitly says agent.role should not be extensible, keeping it as an example structural-role binding. FHIR-55346 later handled the remaining Provenance.entity.role escape-valve concern by adding an other code to provenance-entity-role rather than changing the datatype or required binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because current active source already carries the FHIR-8032 clarification and later final decisions supersede a literal reapplication of the agent.role extensible wording.
